The project would remove the fixed film reactors from the treatment train and add nitrogen removal and membrane aerated biofilm reactor process units to the existing aeration basins to improve and intensify the treatment process.

The Discharger plans to build a horizontal levee on the shore of Harbor Marsh in the Palo Alto Baylands. The horizontal levee would provide multiple benefits , such as sea level rise adaptation, habitat enhancement, and additional wastewater treatment with up to 0.1 MGD of plant effluent.
The project created a 15-acre freshwater pond from previously dry land. With a constructed berm around the pond to prevent stormwater inflows, treated effluent is the only flow into the pond.
